1.

Lord, behold Thy little company, Gathered to break bread! Help us to be still before Thee, As we here remember Thy death.

2.

This death, which has revealed The Father’s love in its height, Who spared not His only Son, That we might share His joy.

3.

Share the Father’s joy in the Son, Now exalted and richly rewarded. Lord Jesus, we behold Thee With all power and glory crowned.

4.

Yet Thou art not ashamed to call us Thy brethren before God, And in our weak hearts Thou Thyself dost raise the sound of praise.
